name: controle-periodicos
description: Controle de servicos periodicos dos condominios (dedetizacao, extintor, reservatorio, AVCB, seguro)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix web install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently -n server,web,ngrok -c blue,magenta,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev" "ngrok http 5173"
